bandReport.notes:
Q88 EXISTS and is fully printed on p16 (left column, between Q87 and the foot of the column). The reported OCR gap is an artifact: the booklet's text layer reads the label as '88,' with a COMMA rather than a period, so a number-scanning regex anchored on 'NN.' skips it. The printed page itself shows a normal period (verified at 10x magnification). No question is missing from this band.

Band edges: Q86 is the first question on p16 and starts clean at the top of the left column (no continuation from p15). Q96 is the last question on p17; its fourth option '(d) Bayazid Bistami' sits well clear of the footer with roughly a third of the right column blank below it, so nothing spills to p18.

Two-column hazard checked explicitly (Rule 1): on p17 the OCR reading order INTERLEAVES Q92's code options with Q96's option block, because the two blocks sit side by side at the same height. Verified against a 4x crop of the page: the numeric code options ('1, 2 and 3' / '1 and 2 only' / '2 and 3 only' / '1 only') are in the LEFT column directly beneath Q92's own 'Select the correct answer using the code given below.' line, and the four Sufi-saint names are in the RIGHT column beneath Q96's stem. Assigned accordingly. Same check applied to p16, where Q88's option block (left column) sits beside Q89's code options (right column).

Nothing on either page belongs to a neighbouring band.
